verdict.rationale: Adyen documents payment links ("Offer payment links"), and its MCP tooling can create, get, and expire them. That implies a vendor-hosted page customers can be sent to without building your own payment UI. Styling customization and localized payment forms are also documented. However, the pack never explicitly describes a hosted, redirect-based checkout page, and the /sessions flow shown sends data to your own client-side application. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a hosted checkout/redirect page, evidence of conversion optimization on that page, independent hands-on corroboration.
